integrity: All calculations reported are reproducible from standalone checker.py. The earliest motivating public source date is the original 2019 arXiv submission, not a revised version.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to noncollinear four-point subsets of F_3^d and unweighted character bases. The exact finite polynomial census is accompanied by an affine-span reduction and a universal Gram-eigenvalue bound; no claim is made for other fields, weighted frames, or independent verification.
title: Sharp ternary Fourier conditioning for four-point caps
